subject: [PATCH RFC v4 09/12] mm/gup: build get_user_page_lookup_vma() on get_user_page_vma()

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch refactors the `get_user_page_lookup_vma()` function to reuse the existing `get_user_page_vma()` helper, eliminating duplicated code and improving performance. The new implementation holds the mmap lock throughout the call, ensuring that the VMA remains valid even in case of a fault. It also preserves the foreign-access permission check and accessed-bit behavior. The patch removes the old implementation and adds an assertion to ensure that the caller holds the mmap lock.
